unavailable.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
unavailable.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

restartNotice.en: The change takes effect at the next start
restartNotice.zh: 更改将在下次启动生效

overriddenNotice.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
overriddenNotice.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效

builtinAgentTeamDescription.en: Enable agent team collaboration and team tools.
builtinAgentTeamDescription.zh: 启用智能体团队协作与团队工具。

builtinAgentTeamWebTitle.zh: 智能体团队 Web 界面

builtinAgentTeamWebDescription.en: View team members, the task board, and teammate sessions in the browser.
builtinAgentTeamWebDescription.zh: 在浏览器中查看团队成员、任务看板和成员会话。

builtinAutoReviewDescription.en: Add an Auto review permission mode that uses the model to assess authorization before each tool call.
builtinAutoReviewDescription.zh: 提供自动审查权限模式，由模型在每次工具调用前判断是否授权。

partsEmpty.en: This plugin pack contains no components.
partsEmpty.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

installDescription.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
installDescription.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。

installGuideIntro.en: Copy any one of these from the plugin's README or release page.
installGuideIntro.zh: 从插件的 README 或发布页面复制以下任意一项。

installGuideIdNote.en: The package name is the npm package name, usually dsh-xxx or @author/plugin; the display name is not one.
installGuideIdNote.zh: 包名即 npm 包名，常见形式为 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名；插件的显示名称不是包名。

installGuideIdHint.en: The part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in the README's install command.
installGuideIdHint.zh: README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

installGuideGitHint.en: The address of the plugin's open-source repository on GitHub; other Git hosts work too.
installGuideGitHint.zh: 插件在 GitHub 上的开源仓库地址，也支持其他 Git 仓库。

installGuidePathHint.en: The absolute path of a plugin directory on this machine, developed here or downloaded.
installGuidePathHint.zh: 本机上插件目录的绝对路径，适用于自行开发或已下载的插件。

installGuideSafety.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
installGuideSafety.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。
